correctness.rationale: The exact domain is the 12-arrow multipath complex of loopless bidirected K4, with no directed cycles. Enumerate 12 vertices, 36 admissible 2-arrow edges, 24 Hamiltonian-path 2-simplices; each positive-dimensional simplex belongs to exactly one of six 4-arrow oriented Hamiltonian-cycle boundaries (four triangles each), and distinct boundaries meet only at isolated arrow vertices. The six-sphere/12-arrow incidence graph has 18 vertices, 24 edges and is connected, giving beta1=7; gluing six simply connected S² spaces along points has homotopy type (∨^7 S¹)∨(∨^6 S²), integrally. The direct simplicial boundary ranks computed independently are rank d1=11 and rank d2=18, yielding reduced H1=Z^7 and H2=Z^6; the homotopy proof supplies torsion-freeness. For g∈S4×C2, the signed fixed-2-sphere contributions and/or simplicial Lefschetz trace give the ten H1 vectors r0=(7,-1,-1,1,-1), r1=(1,-3,1,1,1) and H2 vectors r0=(6,0,2,0,-2), r1=(0,2,-4,0,0). Character inner products give H1=(sgn⊕211)_+⊕31_- and H2=31_+⊕(sgn⊕22)_-. Independent code reconstructs all 48 group actions by signed fixed simplices, with no reliance on the repository verifier. Result is exactly n=4; no higher n or integral group-ring decomposition is claimed.
